scope: One repeat of the same V27a boot_a-only diagnostic on exact Lynx slot A after the first trial lacked a physical boot timestamp and was inconclusive. V19 was restored and verified over pinned SSH; its beacon arrived 117.709 seconds after captured Fastboot USB departure. V27a derives directly from that proven V19 image: only init, its payload metadata, and packaged Wi-Fi supervisor differ. It advertises the actual DHCP address and accepts local SSH readiness without a Nexus acknowledgement. A 180-second post-bootstrap RAM timer requests power-off even on success because automatic health is not included. Arm the image-aware network observer for 1800 seconds and a passive USB transition observer before writing; judge the native boot window from captured USB departure, allowing at least 420 seconds afterward. Retain exact V19 and stock restoration paths. General hold remains active for other images and partitions.
abort_conditions: Unexpected Fastboot identity or slot, image or stock hash mismatch, write error, warming handset, USB attached during native boot, missing authenticated SSH proof through bounded window, unexpected recovery or reboot. Preserve raw logs and restore V19 after the diagnostic.
